An individual was the '''right-hand general''' of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tulak Hord]] before and during his campaigns on [[Battle of Yn|Yn]] and [[Battle of Chabosh (Sith Empire)|Chabosh]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Aloysius Kallig]] in an attempt to gain favor with Hord<ref name="TORE" /> sometime around [[5300 BBY]], near the time of the battles of [[Yn]] and [[Chabosh]].<ref name="Date" />
